CheckTitle: AWS Organization security services are administered from a delegated administrator account and not from the management account
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices
Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/AWS Foundational Security Best Practices
Description: Every security service that has **trusted access** enabled in the **AWS Organization** is required to have a **delegated administrator** that is not the organization **management account**. Registering a delegated administrator is the only way to move organization-wide administration of a service out of the management account.
Risk: Administering **GuardDuty**, **Security Hub**, **Macie**, **Config** or **CloudTrail** from the management account concentrates security monitoring in the one account that **service control policies cannot restrict**. Compromising it both removes the organization guardrails and blinds the detections that would surface the compromise.

Code.Other:
1. Sign in to the AWS Organizations management account
2. Open the AWS Organizations console
3. In the left pane, select **Services**
4. Select the security service reported by this check
5. Choose **Register delegated administrator** and enter the security tooling account ID
6. Repeat for every security service reported by this check

Recommendation.Text: Register a dedicated **security tooling** member account as the **delegated administrator** for every security service integrated with the organization, and keep the **management account** for organization management only. Security operators then need credentials in the security tooling account rather than in the account that SCPs cannot restrict.

Notes: This check requires execution from the organization management account or a delegated administrator account to read the organization trusted access and delegation configuration.
